Class XmlPhoneType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlPhoneType
public class XmlPhoneType extends Object
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="https://phon.ca/ns/session" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://phon-ca.github.io/phon/phon-manual/transcription/ipa_transcription.html#phone">Phon manual section on this topic...</a>

Java class for phoneType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="phoneType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}prefix" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}base"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}combining" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}suffix" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}phlen" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}toneNumber" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
       <attribute name="scType" type="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}syllableConstituentType" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

  • Method Details

    • getPrefix

      public List<String> getPrefix()
      Gets the value of the prefix property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the prefix property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getPrefix().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list String
